class.name: IfcMaterialProperties
class.brief_description: IfcMaterialProperties is defined as an abstract supertype for entities that apply material properties to material definitions. A set of material properties that are assigned to an individual material definiton may be identified by a Name and a Description . NOTE The set of material properties can be assigned to an individual IfcMaterial , a set or composite of materials ( IfcMaterialConstituent ,

members.member: The name given to the set of extended properties.
